title: Me @ Directions EMEA 2026
summary: The author describes two AI-focused sessions at Directions EMEA 2026: fine-tuning open-source language models locally with Business Central data for domain-specific intelligence, and monitoring and governing multiple types of AI agents running within Business Central using Application Insights.
key_points: Organizations can fine-tune open-source LLMs locally using Business Central data and open source tools without sending sensitive data to the cloud
The workflow covers extracting training data from BC's relational model, building datasets in AL, fine-tuning locally, and integrating models back into processes
AI agents (native AL, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, Foundry Agents) running in Business Central need monitoring and governance across different platforms
Application Insights telemetry enables observability, cost tracking, and forecasting for agent workloads with dashboards for throughput, latency, and quality

quotes.text: Organizations want AI that understands their business, but generic LLMs don't know your processes, data model, or operational context
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core challenge that domain-specific fine-tuning addresses

quotes.text: enterprise-grade monitoring blueprint that transforms agent workloads from opaque to transparent, enabling cost control, predictability, and sustainable scaling
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the practical outcome of implementing proper agent observability and governance
